hero.texte: Set your prices in CFA francs. Your customers pay with bitcoin, Wave, Orange Money or Free Money. The money lands in seconds, straight to you.

maquette.alt: Preview of the SatsPoint checkout on a phone

moyens.titre: One screen, every way to pay

etapes.e1Texte: In CFA francs, as usual. SatsPoint converts it to sats at the live rate.
etapes.e2Texte: With their bitcoin wallet or mobile money app. One QR code, nothing to set up.
etapes.e3Texte: The payment is confirmed in seconds, the receipt is ready, the sale is recorded.

fonctions.voixTitre: A checkout that speaks your language
fonctions.voixTexte: Every button has a speaker: listen in Wolof, Serer, Pulaar or Jola. Nobody is left out, even without reading.
fonctions.vitesseTexte: The Lightning network confirms a bitcoin payment in seconds.
fonctions.fondsTexte: Your wallet connects through Nostr Wallet Connect. SatsPoint never holds your money.
fonctions.directTexte: The manager sees the cashier's sale within a second, without reloading.
fonctions.tableauTexte: Revenue, sales, average basket, Excel export in one click.
fonctions.equipeTexte: Owner, manager, cashier: each with their own rights, invited by link.

securite.texte: SatsPoint is designed so that nobody, not even us, can touch your funds.
securite.s1Texte: Bitcoin payments land directly in your own wallet.
securite.s2Texte: Your wallet and mobile money credentials are encrypted (AES-256).
securite.s3Texte: A one-time code protects sensitive accounts.
securite.s4Texte: All the code is public: anyone can check it.

impact.texte: Small merchants lose sales for lack of change, or pay fees on every transaction. SatsPoint opens their shop to digital payments, with no terminal to buy.
impact.c1Texte: of hardware: a phone is enough.
impact.c2Texte: to create a shop and make the first sale.
impact.c3Texte: national languages with voice, plus French and English.

faq.q1: Do I need a bank account?
faq.r1: No. A phone and a free bitcoin wallet are enough. Mobile money goes through your PayTech account or your Wave link.
faq.r2: SatsPoint takes no fee. Only the very low Lightning network fees, or those of your mobile money provider, apply.
faq.r3: Bitcoin payments go straight to your wallet, mobile money payments to your merchant account. SatsPoint never touches the funds.
faq.q4: Do my customers need to know bitcoin?
faq.r4: No. Customers with Wave or Orange Money pay as usual; those with a bitcoin wallet scan the QR code.
faq.q5: What if I can't read well?
faq.r5: Every button has a speaker: listen to the explanation in Wolof, Serer, Pulaar or Jola.
faq.q6: Does the price change with the bitcoin rate?
faq.r6: Your price stays in CFA francs. SatsPoint converts it to sats at the live rate, based on three sources, and locks it for the whole payment.
